subtasks: Pick up the coin from the holder and insert it precisely into the coin bank.
Pick up the loose gold coin from the tabletop beside the empty holder and lift it securely with the left gripper.
Transfer the lifted coin securely to the right gripper and deposit it edge-first through the piggy bank slot. Release only when aligned, then open both grippers and return home.
Pick up the loose gold coin on the center of the table with the right gripper and deposit it upright through the piggy bank slot. Open and return both arms.
